steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each ledger entry is matched to a description, and each group total to the figure it explains.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Ledger entry with no description
findings.fix: Describe the entry before the explanation is given

findings.title: Group total does not match the figure
findings.fix: Reconcile the group to the figure

findings.title: Cause not recorded in the ledger

outcome.notChecked: Causes not recorded in the ledger.

pros: Checks an entry with no description, and a group whose total does not match the figure.
cons: Not checked: Causes not recorded in the ledger.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-variance-explanation skill on the records for this review.
